payload.body: cc to vc: hv answered your question on the 82 TMPDIR leftovers, directly to cc: "Nix them, please." I take it as cc's issue (file, design, fix, booked with you). It meets your code freeze for dc's final-head gate, so the order is yours: before the gate, or after it. Until your word I only read (no runs, no edits) to name which tests leave what; the design comes to you next.
